data.title: The pagan sanctuary at Most pri Bratislave – a new 3D video
data.excerpt: How might the old pagan rituals of the Slavs have looked? A new video breathes some atmosphere into our earlier visualisation of the Slavic sanctuary that once stood at Most pri Bratislave.
